Dave Robinson Stay-at-Home Parent Next Questions people ask about Any.do What is Any.do? Any.do is a to-do list, planner, calendar and shared task board. Small teams use it to plan and track work on shared boards, families use it as a shared organizer, and individuals use it as their personal to-do list. It runs on iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and the web, and more than 50 million people use it. Does Any.do work with ChatGPT and Claude? Yes. Any.do has an official MCP connector that works with ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and other MCP-compatible AI agents. Once connected, your AI can create tasks, set due dates and reminders, update and complete tasks, and read your lists and boards. The connector is free on every plan.
